title: Structured Output Integrity Sentry — config-aware replay & provenance tagging
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight 'Integrity Sentry' service that continuously monitors structured JSON outputs for schema adherence and subtle field-level quality regressions tied to model/config changes. This ticket implements a config-aware replayable probe, provenance tagging of samples, and a lightweight scoring function that prioritizes alerts by likely customer impact.

Motivation:
- We've observed intermittent regressions introduced by model variant swaps and model config deltas (temperature, max_tokens, token_bias). Existing detectors fire noisy alerts without clear attribution to the changed configuration.
- We need an automated, reproducible way to (1) attribute a regression to a specific model/config change, (2) provide an explainable signal (per-field deltas + sample examples), and (3) integrate into rollout gates and alerting with a low false-positive rate.

Scope in this ticket:
- Implement sample provenance tagging at request time (model, config hash, route, customer_id anonymized) and wire into logs and sampling store.
- Build a replay harness that can deterministically re-run a representative sample set against a previous and new configuration to compute delta metrics. The harness should be cheap (sample ~200 per rollout by default) and respect rate limits.
- Design and implement a per-field "impact score": combines schema violations, probability mass changes (token logprobs), and downstream parse failures. Scores are normalized and aggregated to an overall regression severity.
- Create an alert policy and dashboard for the Integrity Sentry: top offending fields, sample examples, confidence band, and suggested rollback reason. Integrate with Console rollouts so canary failures can automatically trigger a rollback recommendation.

Non-goals:
- Full fuzzy semantic evaluation across free text fields (this ticket focuses on structured/typed outputs).
- Replacing the full eval pipeline — this is a detection/attribution layer that leverages the existing eval infra for deeper investigations.

Implementation notes / design decisions:
- Provenance tagging: include a stable config_hash computed from model_version + relevant mutable params (temperature, top_p, max_new_tokens, system prompts) and route metadata. Save minimal per-sample metadata to S3/warehouse for replay.
- Replay harness: deterministic seeding for stochastic components; support both "previous" and "candidate" targets; allow configurable sample selectors (random, stratified by route, failure-biased).
- Scoring: field_level_score = w1*schema_violation + w2*parse_failure + w3*median_logprob_drop. We will start with w1=0.6, w2=0.3, w3=0.1 and tune after 2 weeks of telemetry.
- Alerting: only surface alerts when aggregated severity > threshold OR when >10% of samples show hard schema violations. Throttling window of 1 hour to reduce noise.

Trade-offs considered:
- Sampling budget vs coverage: smaller sample reduces cost but may miss low-frequency regressions. We choose a default of 200 with a fast path to increase to 1000 for high-risk rollouts.
- Running replay synchronously vs async: async to avoid blocking rollouts, but must complete within rollout window (default 30 minutes).
- Using token logprobs (expensive for some backends) vs only structural checks: keep token-based signals optional behind a config flag to control cost per-deployment.

Acceptance criteria:
- Integrity Sentry produces per-rollout report comparing previous and candidate configurations with: per-field delta table, top-5 failing samples, and an overall severity score.
- Reports exposed via Console rollout UI and generate an alert in PagerDuty / Slack when severity crosses threshold.
- Replay harness run for an internal canary (runtime-1.20 canary) and detected at least one intentional regression introduced by a synthetic change in unit tests.
- Unit tests for provenance hashing, replay determinism, and scoring logic added and pass in CI.

Success metrics (first 30 days):
- Precision of surfaced schema-violation alerts >= 85% against hand-labeled evaluation set.
- Mean time-to-attribution (time from alert to identified model/config change) < 45 min.
- False positive alert rate < 10% for non-release churn windows.

Rollout plan:
1) Feature-flagged rollout to "internal" workspace for 1 week (sample size 500, use token signals).
2) Validate against curated regression corpus and run postmortem of any misses.
3) Enable for selected customers on staged rollout with reduced sampling.
4) Flip default on for all canaries after 4 weeks and tune thresholds.

Monitoring / Observability:
- New Console dashboard: "Integrity Sentry -> Active Rollouts" (list of recent reports, severity bands).
- Per-route historical trend chart for per-field severity.
- Alert ETA track: time to replay completion and time to open PR.

- Design doc (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Integrity+Sentry+Design
acceptance_criteria: Per-rollout report with per-field deltas, top-5 sample examples, and overall severity score is generated for candidate vs previous config.
Console shows Integrity Sentry results on rollout page and triggers alerts when thresholds exceeded.
Replay harness deterministic for fixed seed and sample selector; unit tests cover determinism.
At least one synthetic regression detected in internal canary run and end-to-end alerting exercised.
Integration tests in CI that validate provenance tagging and scoring logic pass.
Documentation updated (README + runbook) and on-call runbook created for handling alerts.
updates: 2025-03-04: Ticket created by Asha Kapoor. Initial spike completed; prototype for provenance tagging exists in staging logs.
2025-03-06: Design review with PM (Lena Ortiz) and SRE (Marco Chen). Decided to keep token-logprob signals opt-in to control cost.
2025-03-07: PR #1137 opened implementing provenance metadata and sample store schema. Requesting eng review from Jonah and Priya.
2025-03-09: Jonah Greene implemented replay harness core loop; discovered nondeterminism from third-party tokenizer — added deterministic tokenizer wrapper.
2025-03-10: Integration test failing intermittently in CI due to sampling race; added mutex to sample-store writer. Moving to In Progress.
Next: finalize scoring weights, add Console widgets, and run internal canary against runtime-1.20 on 2025-03-12.
notes: Decision log: prefer conservative thresholds at launch to avoid alert fatigue. We'll iterate with empirical telemetry.
Follow-up work (separate ticket): add field-level explainers using counterfactual prompts (TBD).
Security note: provenance stores must redact PII and use customer_id hashing. Coordinate with Security (ticket SEC-3301) before wide rollout.
